name: Pharaoh-hophra
bio: Pharaoh-hophra, king of Egypt, hosted the Jewish refugees who fled there after Gedaliah's assassination. Jeremiah prophesied that just as the LORD had handed Zedekiah of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar, he would likewise hand Pharaoh-hophra over to his enemies, as proof that Jeremiah's warnings against taking refuge in Egypt would prove true (Jeremiah 44:30).
